data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 650k (2014: GBP 343k unfavourable deviation) was experienced during the year.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 3002 reported a favourable prior accident year runoff (a release) of GBP 0.65m in 2015 against opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 3.303m (2014). The movement is described as a prior accident year release and no specific loss events or causes are identified in the report; the change appears to reflect favourable claims development on prior years.
raw_causal_phrases: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 650k (2014: GBP 343k unfavourable deviation) was experienced during the year.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet 'Long term business provision' 2014 comparative column. Prior year movement taken from Note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which states a GBP 650k favourable run-off (treated here as gross). The report does not attribute the movement to specific events or underwriting years and does not explicitly label the GBP 650k as 'gross' vs 'net', but the note title indicates it is the prior year's provision movement (gross). Lob mapping to 'Accident & Health' is inferred from the syndicate's description as writing term life/long term business.
